text: The file-documenter watchdog fires even when source files are absent from agent_workspace — if the AEE extraction pipeline committed only KB records (not source files), the file-documenter cannot proceed and correctly returns [PASS] on every watchdog cycle; fix requires the extraction pipeline to also commit source files or a pipeline design change to allow documentation from KB records alone.

The file-documenter requires 'Extract Log' registered via aee-artifact, not just the raw .aee/extract-log.jsonl file — if only the raw file exists, aee-artifact path 'Extract Log' returns not-found and the documenter correctly returns [PASS].

When the user requests a workspace reset and re-clone, force-reset agent_workspace to main with 'git reset --hard origin/main && git push --force origin agent_workspace' — this clears all pipeline artifacts and pipeline state so a fresh extraction cycle can begin.
